title: Adrian Leemann
text:
I am a full professor of German sociolinguistics at the University of Bern. I study how and why the way people speak varies and changes across regions, generations and social groups, in Swiss German, German and English, using large-scale data from fieldwork, smartphone apps and perception experiments.

    Privacy statement
    This website does not use cookies, tracking, advertising or social media plugins. Apart from the visitor counter described below, it does not load fonts, videos or scripts from third parties. Links to other websites, for example publishers or YouTube, only take effect when you click them; those sites have their own privacy policies.
    To see how many people visit the site, I count page views with GoatCounter. It sets no cookies, does not store IP addresses and cannot identify individual visitors. It keeps only totals, for example how often a page was viewed and from which website visitors arrived.
    The site is hosted on GitHub Pages (GitHub, Inc.). To operate and secure the service, the host records technical access data such as IP addresses. See the GitHub privacy statement.
